meta.layout: countries[ISO].series[variable] is an array aligned index-for-index with countries[ISO].years; missing values are null
meta.fidelity: Raw conversion. No rescaling, interpolation, deflation or gap-filling. Derived quantities (real returns etc.) belong in model code.
meta.variable_descriptions_note: Descriptions are author-supplied summaries for the variables RATES is likely to use, NOT copied from the JST documentation. Verify units against the official codebook before relying on them. Undescribed variables are carried through unchanged.

capital_tr.description: Return on total wealth, weighted average of housing/equity/bond/bill (fraction)

risky_tr.description: Return on risky assets, housing and equity (fraction)

safe_tr.description: Return on safe assets, bonds and bills (fraction)
